actions.convert-json-to-xml.props.attrib: Field to add your tag's attributes
actions.convert-xml-to-json.props.ignore: Ignore XML tag attributes during parsing. When unchecked, attributes are included in the output with a "@_" prefix (e.g. id="42" becomes {"@_id": "42"}).
actions.convert-xml-to-json.props.keepLe: Keep numbers that start with a zero as text so values like ZIP codes, IDs and account numbers are not changed (e.g. "02134" stays "02134" instead of becoming 2134). Other numbers are still converted to numbers.
actions.create-xml.description: Build an XML document from JSON, with attributes, repeated elements, CDATA and an optional XML declaration
actions.create-xml.props.attributePrefix: Keys starting with this prefix become attributes. Defaults to "@_", the prefix Convert XML to JSON uses.
actions.create-xml.props.cdataKey.descri: Key whose value is written as a CDATA section, so it is not escaped. Defaults to "#cdata".
actions.create-xml.props.includeDeclarat: Start the output with <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>. To use a different declaration, add a "?xml" key to your JSON instead, e.g. {"?xml": {"@_version": "1.0", "@_standalone": "yes"}}.
actions.create-xml.props.json.descriptio: Each key becomes an element and each list item becomes a repeated element. Keys starting with "@_" become attributes, "#text" sets the text of an element that has attributes, and "#cdata" writes a CDATA section. Example: {"book": {"@_id": "1", "title": "Dune", "tag": ["scifi", "classic"]}}. The output of Convert XML to JSON can be used as-is.
actions.create-xml.props.listItemElement: Element name for each item when the JSON itself is a list. Defaults to "item".
actions.create-xml.props.prettyPrint.des: Put each element on its own line; text content is never changed.
actions.create-xml.props.rootElement.des: Wraps the output in one element with this name. Leave empty if your JSON already has a single top-level key. If the JSON is a list or has several top-level keys and this is empty, "root" is used.
actions.create-xml.props.selfCloseEmptyE: Write empty values as <tag/> instead of <tag></tag>.
actions.create-xml.props.textKey.descrip: Key that holds the text of an element that also has attributes. Defaults to "#text".
description: Extensible Markup Language for storing and transporting data
